summary: Final question: whether selective partitioning of mixed transcribed RNA can cause an internal RNA-poor phase and rising image hollow-area ratio. S06 returned five pre-cutoff abstracts; S06_S2 offers broad phase-behavior support for charge-rich condensate models including disordered ssRNA, while no retrieved abstract addresses internal cavity nucleation. C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed successfully (returncode 0) as a conditional closed two-species equilibrium calculation. At x_V^L=0.01, the central values map to x_V^D=0.27665 on tie-line 1 and 0.00337 on tie-line 2; the direction reverses. The result neither predicts cavity formation nor maps to f. H1 remains explicitly provisional and H2 remains viable.

candidates.target: Explain emergence and persistence of internal RNA-poor cavities measured by arithmetic mean per-droplet hollow-area ratio f(t), and distinguish composition-linked demixing from reaction-condition/carryover.
known_relations: f_A(0,4,8,12,24h)=0.01487,0.00544,0.00444,0.00406,0.00446; f_B=0.01381,0.01592,0.02393,0.04028,0.08918. Two preparations per condition; fields and objects are not independent preparation replicates.

C01: reference DNA read fraction 0.9466; listed non-reference fractions sum to 0.0500; total is 0.9966. Repeated/rearranged alignment is nonunique. DNA frequencies do not establish transcribed RNA composition or active valence.
E02/fraction_dev: endpoint hollow-area means M near 0, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412; exact mixture ratios, RNA yields, and matched carryover are absent.

C04: central K_reference/K_variant are 238.54/9032.08 on tie-line 1 and 525.12/176.01 on line 2. Variant K on line 0 is undefined because dilute variant concentration is zero; reported marginal error rectangles are not confidence intervals.

C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed with returncode 0. Conditional map x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.27665 on line 1 and 0.00337 on line 2; enrichment direction reverses across tie-lines. The code reports K error rectangles but does not propagate them into composition-map uncertainty bands.
C03 lacks persistent same-droplet cavity-state and area trajectories. C04 lacks phase volumes, time-resolved production/flux, and cavity-matched spatial concentrations.

S06_S2 (2025-02-11, abstract only) describes a charge-informed coarse-grained model for charge-rich condensates including disordered ssRNA and reports charge-blockiness, stoichiometry, and salt effects on modeled phase behavior. It does not establish an internal-cavity relation.

hypotheses.status: new provisional hypothesis; not empirically confirmed
hypotheses.statement: If transcription produces RNA populations with different effective interaction valence, selective partitioning may shift local composition across a coexistence boundary inside an initially RNA-rich condensate. The explicitly new, unverified bridge is that this shift can nucleate and stabilize an internal RNA-poor phase, causing the per-droplet hollow-area ratio to rise after a local composition threshold.
hypotheses.status_note: The literature supports broad phase-behavior sensitivity in some charged RNA-containing condensate models, not internal cavities. C04 conditional maps reverse enrichment direction between tie-lines. No evidence links the listed DNA variants to RNA yield, valence, cavity partitioning, or image area.

hypotheses.statement: Amplification-associated carryover or another changed reaction condition alters transcription, ionic environment, or condensate organization without sequence composition mediating the hollow-area change.

gaps.description: No eligible source or supplied measurement provides a constitutive relation from mixed RNA composition and selective partitioning to internal demixing, cavity nucleation/persistence, or observed area ratio. Retrieved abstracts support broader phase behavior or cross-system analogies only.
No matched time-resolved measurement connects template composition to transcribed RNA composition; DNA read frequencies cannot substitute for RNA concentrations.
No validated map connects f to phase volume, local concentration, or same-droplet cavity dynamics.

variables_units.name: f
variables_units.meaning: arithmetic mean of per-droplet hollow area divided by filled area

variables_units.name: x_V^L
variables_units.meaning: variant RNA mass fraction in dilute phase on a fixed assay basis

variables_units.name: x_V^D
variables_units.meaning: variant RNA mass fraction in dense phase on the same basis

variables_units.name: c_i^D
variables_units.meaning: RNA species i concentration in dense phase

variables_units.name: c_i^L
variables_units.meaning: RNA species i concentration in dilute phase

variables_units.name: phi
variables_units.meaning: latent internal RNA-poor phase volume fraction

equations: K_i=c_i^D/c_i^L when c_i^L>0; otherwise K_i is undefined.
For a closed two-species equilibrium mixture on one applicable tie-line: x_V^D=K_V*x_V^L/[K_V*x_V^L+K_R*(1-x_V^L)].
Inverting for a hypothesized dense-phase threshold x_star: x_V,L*=x_star*K_R/[K_V*(1-x_star)+x_star*K_R]. This maps a chosen threshold only; it does not predict that one exists.
H1 phenomenology: phi=0 below x_star and phi>0 may occur at/above x_star. This is an unestimated hypothesis, not a supplied constitutive law.
Unknown observation map: f=h(phi,cavity geometry,droplet selection,segmentation); f cannot be equated with phi.

parameters_ranges.name: K_R and K_V
parameters_ranges.range: Use only C04 tie-line-specific estimates and marginal error rectangles; do not pool lines or call rectangles confidence intervals.

initial_boundary_conditions: Similar t=0 group means do not establish equal microscopic state or RNA composition.
H1 conditionally assumes initial local composition below x_star; unobserved.
Time-varying RNA production, phase volumes, phase fluxes, and cavity boundary conditions are unavailable.
observation_mapping: f is a mean of object-level image area ratios, not concentration, phase volume fraction, or free energy.
C04 concentrations cannot be converted to f without cavity-matched concentrations, geometry, and phase volumes.
Field SEM and object counts do not estimate preparation-level uncertainty.
alternatives: H2: carryover or reaction conditions alter transcription or condensate organization without sequence mediation.
Population selection, coalescence, or detection changes may alter aggregate f; C03 cannot test persistent cavity states.
Segmentation or sampling effects may alter f; threshold robustness is unavailable.
In the conditional identity, equal K_V=K_R gives x_V^D=x_V^L and removes enrichment/depletion.

predictions.statement: At fixed reaction chemistry and total RNA production, increasing directly measured variant RNA fraction across a threshold should increase cavity-bearing-droplet probability or object-level hollow-area ratio under H1. H2 predicts no systematic variant-fraction dependence after carryover and reaction chemistry are matched.
predictions.measure: Controlled RNA composition series with direct RNA composition, per-droplet hollow-area ratios, matched carryover, and independent preparations.
predictions.limitation: No physical experiment is available in this run; existing length-fraction endpoints are not a controlled composition series.

predictions.statement: Using C04 central values under the closed-mixture assumptions, line 1 maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.27665 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.02573. Line 2 maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.00337 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.74896. Thus threshold mapping depends on tie-line and no universal enrichment direction follows.
predictions.limitation: The calculation uses central endpoint K values; error rectangles were reported for K but not propagated to x_V^D bands. Equilibrium, tie-line transferability, closed two-species composition, and common mass/mole basis are unverified. It predicts neither cavities nor f.

final.question_and_reason: Does selective partitioning of a mixed transcribed RNA population cause an internal RNA-poor phase and increasing B hollow-area ratio? This is the missing bridge between DNA/template heterogeneity, endpoint phase partitioning, and the image phenotype.
final.increment: The eligible literature offers limited support for composition/electrostatic control of phase behavior in charged RNA-containing condensate models and a separate HP1/DNA analogy; neither addresses internal cavities. A successful conditional partition calculation shows enrichment can be strong or reversed depending on tie-line, weakening any universal direction claim.
final.new_hypotheses: H1: if transcribed RNA populations differ in effective interaction valence, selective partitioning may shift local composition across a coexistence boundary and nucleate/stabilize an internal RNA-poor phase. This internal-cavity bridge is explicitly new and untested. H2 remains a viable reaction-condition/carryover alternative.
final.actual_derivation_or_computation: C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed with returncode 0 using C04 phase_measurements.json. For x_V^D=K_V*x_V^L/[K_V*x_V^L+K_R*(1-x_V^L)], line 1 K_V=9032.08, K_R=238.54 maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.27665 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.02573. Line 2 K_V=176.01, K_R=525.12 maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.00337 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.74896. Unit-interval, endpoint, and equal-K checks passed. This is conditional equilibrium composition arithmetic, not a cavity computation; K error rectangles were not propagated to composition-map bands.
final.discriminating_prediction: With reaction chemistry/carryover and total RNA production matched, increasing directly quantified variant RNA fraction across a candidate threshold should raise cavity-bearing-droplet probability or per-droplet hollow-area ratio under H1. H2 predicts no systematic variant-fraction dependence after matching. This prediction is prospective and untested.
final.evidence_support_conflict_untested: B f rises 0.01381 to 0.08918 from 0 to 24 h; E02 length-fraction endpoints differ; C04 has species-specific partition ratios; S06_S2 supports broad phase behavior in charged RNA-containing condensate models. Limits: two preparations, DNA frequency is not RNA composition, E02 lacks carryover matching and exact composition, C04 reverses direction across tie-lines and lacks cavity-specific measurements, abstracts provide no cavity mechanism, and f is not concentration or phase volume fraction. Same-droplet cavity trajectories are absent.
final.decision: Complete T05 as a literature and conditional-computation assessment. Retain H1 as a provisional hypothesis, keep G1 open, and do not claim a mechanism is established; H2 is not ruled out.
final.dissent: Do not treat conditional partition enrichment or broad phase-separation literature as confirmation that RNA mixture demixing causes the observed cavities.
final.next_experiment: A future randomized RNA-composition series should match carryover, salt/ionic conditions, and total RNA production; quantify RNA composition and phase-resolved concentrations directly, then longitudinally track per-droplet cavity appearance and area across independent preparations.
final.limitations: All retrieved literature evidence is abstract-only. No target-specific full text, direct internal-cavity relation, empirical confirmation, or new physical experiment was available. Partition calculations assume a closed two-species equilibrium mixture and transferable tie-line values and do not map to f.
